verdict.rationale: Gecko lets you scan a pasted public repo URL or an uploaded ZIP with 'No provider connection required' (gecko-security-docs-7), and its hybrid deployment keeps scanning, storage and AI inference inside the customer's own AWS account (gecko-security-docs-13), both of which imply some isolation from live production systems. However, there is no explicit sandbox/staging environment concept, no documentation of ephemeral or isolated execution during scans, and no claim about avoiding production data specifically. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/test environment feature, documentation on data isolation guarantees during scanning, and independent confirmation that scans never touch production systems.
